items.title: Drame à N’Djaména : un véhicule finit sa course dans une habitation
items.summary: Un véhicule a percuté une concession ce dimanche à N’Djaména, faisant un mort et deux blessés graves, un drame qui relance le débat sur la sécurité routière.

items.title: Tripoli se prépare à accueillir le sommet Afrique-Turquie
items.summary: À l'approche du sommet Afrique-Turquie prévu en décembre à Tripoli, les autorités libyennes, turques et l'Union africaine intensifient leur coordination sécuritaire et logistique.

items.title: Building a Sustainable Global Security Shield Against Natural Disasters Through International Cooperation
items.summary: As extreme weather events mount, enhancing cross-border cooperation, technology sharing, and early warning systems is vital for building a sustainable global security shield against natural disasters.

items.title: African Coffee Finds a Growing Foothold in China Through Trade Fairs and Zero-Tariff Policies
items.summary: Boosted by zero-tariff policies and platforms like the CIIE, African coffee from producers in Uganda and Kenya is gaining strong momentum and expanding its footprint across the Chinese market.

items.title: Sharing the Benefits of Openness to Promote Common Prosperity
items.summary: As the Asia-Pacific region embraces deeper economic integration, the recent China International Import Expo has served as a vital platform for APEC economies to foster growth, innovation, and shared prosperity.

items.title: تشاد: حركة الإنقاذ الوطني تثمن جولة رئيس الجمهورية في المحافظات المتضررة
